TYPE CHECK: The candidate value is a numeric count, which is the correct type for technical_replicates.
SOURCE CHECK: The paper states "each sample was measured in triplicate in DDA and DIA mode", which refers to the MS acquisition of the samples.
TRUTH CHECK: The term "measured in triplicate" indicates 3 replicates per sample. However, in proteomics, "measured in triplicate" often refers to biological replicates if the samples themselves are biological replicates, or technical replicates if the same sample is injected three times. In this study, the "gold standard spike-in sample set" consists of 5 distinct samples (different spike-in concentrations), and each of these 5 samples was measured 3 times. Since these are the same prepared samples being measured multiple times, these are technical replicates.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The value "3" covers the replication described for the MS analysis of the GS samples.
